title: Aadhavan
desc: Dr Kulkarni hires Aadhavan, a sharpshooter, to kill magistrate Subramaniam who is determined to reveal the list of culprits involved in organ trafficking cases.

title: I.G.
desc: Inspector General Durga Prasad gets appointed as the head of an anti-terrorism squad. However, a revelation soon forces him to choose between his family and his duty.

title: Googly
desc: Sharath leads a carefree life until he meets Swathi at a college event. A friendship turns into a mutual attraction, but a small misunderstanding causes them to part ways.

title: Kaala
desc: Haridev Abhayankar, a corrupt minister, wishes to seize Dharavi's lucrative land for his own gain. However, Karikaalan, the locality's godfather, fights to protect his people's rights and assets.

title: 7 (Seven)
desc: A man called Seven goes the extra mile for Anu, who demands that don Kaali be killed, and fulfills her wish expecting her love in return, but he is in for a shock.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Saamy
desc: Aarusaamy, a police officer, accepts bribes from Perumal, a gangster, in order to maintain peace in his district. However, circumstances force him to go against Perumal.
